name: BMW M5
description: A high-performance luxury sedan with twin-turbo V8 engine.

details.fullDescription: The BMW M5 is the pinnacle of performance sedans. Built with a hand-assembled twin-turbo V8 engine, it delivers blistering acceleration while maintaining everyday comfort. With M xDrive all-wheel drive, adaptive suspension, and a sport-tuned chassis, the M5 is equally at home on a race track or a daily commute.

name: Mercedes AMG GT
description: Sleek sports car with handcrafted AMG engine and premium interior.

details.fullDescription: The Mercedes-AMG GT is a masterpiece of engineering and design. Every AMG GT engine is hand-built by a single engineer, delivering raw power wrapped in stunning styling. The interior features premium leather, cutting-edge technology, and a driver-focused cockpit that makes every journey unforgettable.

name: Audi RS7
description: Powerful fastback with quattro all-wheel drive and sporty design.

details.fullDescription: The Audi RS7 blends breathtaking performance with the practicality of a fastback body. Its quattro all-wheel drive system and adaptive air suspension provide confidence in all conditions. The interior is a showcase of Audi's MMI technology with dual touchscreens and premium Bang & Olufsen sound.

name: Porsche 911
description: Iconic sports car with rear-engine layout and razor-sharp handling.

details.fullDescription: The Porsche 911 is one of the most iconic sports cars ever built. Its unique rear-engine layout gives it a driving feel unlike anything else on the road. With decades of motorsport heritage, the 911 delivers a perfect balance of everyday usability and track-ready performance.

name: Lamborghini Urus
description: Super SUV combining Lamborghini DNA with everyday usability.

details.fullDescription: The Lamborghini Urus redefines the SUV segment by infusing supercar DNA into a practical yet ferocious machine. With a twin-turbo V8, active torque vectoring, and four selectable drive modes, the Urus is as capable on a track as it is on a mountain road. Its bold Italian design turns heads everywhere.

name: Ferrari F8
description: Mid-rear engined sports car with 710 hp twin-turbo V8 power.

details.fullDescription: The Ferrari F8 Tributo is a tribute to Ferrari's most powerful V8 engines in history. Its mid-rear mounted twin-turbo V8 screams to a 8,000 rpm redline, delivering an intoxicating soundtrack alongside brutal acceleration. Aerodynamic innovations from Ferrari's XX programme make it the most advanced mid-rear engined V8 Ferrari ever.
